newsitem.title: USA: BW/IP sees Q1 results below year ago.
newsitem.headline: BW/IP sees Q1 results below year ago.

text.p: BW/IP Inc said Thursday that despite its strong outlook, it expects first quarter results to be below year-earlier figures because of several shipments that have shifted to later in the year.
These shifts are inherent in a business that depends on large individual shipments and long lead times, it said.
BW/IP said that for the past several years it has typically reported a slow first quarter followed by three stronger quarters.
The outlook for its markets and its underlying operating results for 1997 holds to this pattern and should result in double-digit growth for the year, it said.
